scope.contaminationAssessment: This v4 applies only the Owner’s explicit L3 lexical selection to v3: 玩具 is the selected direct nominal object. The cumulative L1–L5 capability path, Variant A/B direction, typed relationship semantics, and all non-L3 lexical choices remain unchanged. evidenceCatalog.claim: TBCL Level 1 describes simple words and phrases for personal life; Listening L-1-3 covers everyday greetings and short phrases; Speaking S-1-2 covers personal information and S-1-3 greetings/thanks. This supports broad capability scope only, not this proposal's exact expressions or sequence.

TBCL Level 2 describes simple words/phrases and short sentences for daily life; Speaking S-2-2 covers expressing self/friends' interests and interacting; Listening L-2-1 covers personal questions. This supports a possible progression endpoint, not an official five-lesson sequence or required mastery threshold.

CCCC is designed for non-native Chinese-speaking children ages 7–12, considers child cognitive/language development, and uses child-life contexts including leisure activities. This informs age/context relevance only; no CCCC task, target order, item, or expected load is copied.
CC-CEDICT item data is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribution, change indication, and share-alike apply. This source is not relicensed under TongXuan repository MIT.

The peer-introduction-to-preference-exchange theme, candidate targets, target load, typed relationship distinctions, recycling, and sequence are TongXuan hypotheses. TBCL/CCCC do not mandate them. Frequency evidence is unavailable in the cited lexical source and remains UNVERIFIED.

Character-level SRS is UNRESOLVED. Character recognition is proposed separately; no character ID is placed in srsReviewTargets because the cited framework and lexical references do not support a character-level review/mastery unit.

lexicalDecisionGates.comparisonConclusion: CC-CEDICT/MDBG lookups provide only candidate forms, Pinyin, basic senses, and item provenance; they do not rank frequency, child familiarity, frame naturalness, cognitive burden, or sequence. The Owner selected 玩具 in the hash-bound v3 REVISE record as a TongXuan curriculum hypothesis. That Owner decision, not TBCL/CCCC/CC-CEDICT evidence, selects the active L3 target. All other candidate records remain comparison provenance and are inactive targets in v4.
